com.esignal.jstandard.managers

Interface AnalyticsManager

  • All Superinterfaces:
    ResourceManager
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    ProxyManager

    public interface AnalyticsManager
extends ResourceManager
    Purpose of this class is to provide the Analytics data.

    AnalyticsManager allows users to request Analytics data . It is in the form of a traditional asynchronous response. AnalyticsRequestListener is required to be passed as part of the request method. Also, AnalyticsRequest object should be populated with appropriate request information e.g. request query , turnaround and response type.

    Analytics response is sent to the listener onResponse(). Analytics response information is wrapped as a String object that can be retrieved using the AnalyticsEvent. Also, all request calls are treated separately, they do not depend on each other, thus if the same listener instance is being used on multiple requests than it's clients responsibility to manage onResponse() per symbol.

    We will run through a simple usage of AnalyticsManager. Let's create a factory first. The getFactory() method will retrieves the default implementation of the Factory. The implementation can be changed by calling other getFactory(...) methods OR overriding property "jstandard.resourcemanagerfactory.name" in jstandard.properties. ResourceManagerFactory factory = ResourceManagerFactory.getFactory();

    Now create a AnalyticsManager using the factory. AnalyticsManager analyticsManager = factory.createAnalyticsManager();

    To start the connection we now need to create instances of ConnectionSettings and ConnectionListener. (Implement MyConnectionListener) ConnectionSettings myConnectionSettings = new ConnectionSettings("myhost", "myusername", "mypassword"); //If proxy settings are required //myConnectionSettings.setProxyInfo("phost", pport, "puser", "ppass"); ConnectionListener myConnectionListener = new MyConnectionListener(); analyticsManager.connect(myConnectionSettings, myConnectionListener); At the start the connection listener will receive an event of connecting and after successful connection connected event.

    To get the response for the analytics request, let's make a request to the AnalyticsManager with a JSON request. But before that we also need to have an implementation of the AnalyticsRequestListener. Fill the AnalyticsRequest object and pass it to the manager along with the listener: 

     
        AnalyticsRequestListener myAnalyticsRequestListener = new MyAnalyticsRequestListener();
        String jsonQuery = "......";
        ANALYTICS_REQUEST_FORMAT format = ANALYTICS_REQUEST_FORMAT.JSON;
        Long turnAround = generateUniqueTurnAround();
        AnalyticsRequest analyticsRequest = new DefaultAnalyticsRequest(jsonQuery, turnAround, format);
        analyticsManager.request(analyticsRequest, myAnalyticsRequestListener);
    The listener will be receiving the response for the request query.

    To receive the response data please implement AnalyticsRequestListener' onResponse method. From AnalyticsEvent get the response object which should have the response information. The response object is of type String. 

     
        public void onResponse(AnalyticsEvent analyticsEvent) {
                if (log.isDebugEnabled()) {
                        log.debug(LoggingUtil.sanitize("Analytics listener response received with:" + analyticsEvent.getResponse()));
                }
                System.out.println("Analytics response: " + analyticsEvent.getResponse());
                System.out.println("Analytics response turnAround: " + analyticsEvent.getTurnAround());
        }

    Disconnect from the manager in the end. analyticsManager.disconnect();
